find: Micro-fibres are synthetic fibres with a diameter of less than one denier — finer than a strand of silk.
replace: Micro-fibres are very fine synthetic fibres. Denier measures how fine a fibre is, not how wide it is, and a micro-fibre is finer than one denier — finer than a strand of silk.
note: F7: denier is a linear density, not a diameter.

find: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS), which fuses polymer or metal powder with a laser and is suitable for production-grade engineering parts without support material. Airbus uses metal SLS to produce titanium brackets and connectors for aircraft cabins
replace: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS), which fuses polymer powder such as nylon with a laser. SLS needs no support material because the loose powder holds the part up. Metal powder is printed by a closely related process, selective laser melting (SLM), which melts the powder completely. Airbus uses metal powder printing to make titanium brackets and connectors for aircraft
note: F8: SLS sinters polymer powder; metal powder is melted by SLM/DMLS.

expect: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) — fusing metal powder with a laser to build production-grade components.
value: Selective laser melting — a laser melts titanium powder layer by layer to build the part.
